about: Written by tools/codex_export.gd: the code's own values when the codex was last exported. Don't edit.

cleave.name: Holy Slam
cleave.desc: Leap at the cursor and bring the sword down in a burst of white light: 160% weapon damage to everything around the blow, knocking them back and stunning them for 1 second.

nova.name: Holy Nova
nova.desc: A ring of holy fire bursts outward, burning enemies within 7 metres.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Dash toward the cursor, smashing through enemies and knocking them back.

cry.name: Battle Cry
cry.desc: Rally yourself: +40% damage and +50% defense for 12 seconds. Stuns nearby foes.

rend.name: Spectral Rend
rend.desc: Lunge at the foe ahead and tear through it with elongated spectral claws: two rakes for 90% weapon damage each. Every soul the claws tear out flies back and heals you.

siphon.name: Soul Siphon
siphon.desc: Reach out and hook a spectral tether into an enemy: for 2.5 seconds it stands rigid while the tether drains it (about 180% weapon damage in all) and heals you a third of what it takes, and it is slowed after. A soul torn loose heals you more. The tether holds while you fight on.

step.name: Shadow Step
step.desc: Come apart into mist and re-form at the cursor, spinning into a claw strike round where you land for 130% weapon damage. For a moment after, blows pass through you. The shade you left behind collapses and hurts.

grasp.name: Haunting Grasp
grasp.desc: Slam the ground: spectral hands burst out of the earth around the cursor, seizing every enemy within 3.5 metres for 110% weapon damage, dragging them inward and holding them fast for 2.5 seconds.

phantom.name: Phantom Assault
phantom.desc: Split into three phantoms that streak through the enemies ahead in a fan, each tearing everything in its path for 120% weapon damage, then strike with your own claws.

night.name: Eternal Night
night.desc: Rise and bring down the night over 9 metres: a scream of terror (150% weapon damage, enemies hurled back and frozen with fear), then the dark feeds on everything in it while you hang untouchable above it, and it collapses into your slam for 200%. +40% damage for 12 seconds.

fists.name: Molten Fists
fists.desc: A slow, heavy two-fisted blow: your fists catch fire as you draw back, then crack the ground open ahead of you. Everything in the wedge takes 300% weapon damage plus magma and is set alight. Branded enemies take 30% more and lose the Brand. Dodge to cancel it.

icharge.name: Infernal Charge
icharge.desc: Paw the ground, then charge head-down up to 9 metres along a burning line everyone can see. You stop on the first champion or player you hit: it takes 120% weapon damage plus magma, is staggered and Branded. Lesser monsters are bowled aside.

cslam.name: Fault of the Pit
cslam.desc: Slam the ground and split it in a line 7 metres long across your aim. After a glowing warning it erupts: everything on it takes 133% weapon damage plus magma, is thrown up and Branded. The fault stays molten for 4 seconds: crossing it burns and slows by 35%.

hurl.name: Brimstone Hurl
hurl.desc: Tear a molten boulder out of the ground and lob it up to 14 metres; its shadow shows where it will land. A direct hit (1.3 metres) deals 77% weapon damage plus magma and Brands; the edge (2.6 metres) half. No cooldown: throw again as soon as the throw is done. It shatters into burning shards.

grip.name: Hellgrip
grip.desc: Hurl a molten chain with an iron claw 7.5 metres: the first enemy it hooks is dragged to you, hoisted and smashed into the ground for 320% weapon damage plus magma. Bosses drag you to them instead. A Branded target gives back 30% of the cooldown.

wrath.name: Wrath of the Pit
wrath.desc: Fold your wings round you for up to 2 seconds (press again to end it early): you take 50% less damage, can't be stunned or moved, and store the damage as heat. Then burst out: everything within 6 metres takes 100% weapon damage plus the stored heat (up to 30% of your life), is hurled back and frozen with fear. For 6 seconds you deal +40% damage and meteors rain on the enemies round you.

drain.name: Drain Life
drain.desc: Latch a green beam onto an enemy and pull the life out of it. The beam forks to up to 3 enemies near your target and everything it drains heals you. Hold Q to keep draining (costs mana each second).

blight.name: Blight Bolt
blight.desc: Hurl a howling skull of blight. It bursts where it lands and leaves a plague pool that rots enemies standing in it for 4 seconds.

shackles.name: Soul Shackles
shackles.desc: Chains of fel fire snap out to every enemy within 7 metres, damaging them and binding them in place for 2.5 seconds.

pierce.name: Fire Arrow
pierce.desc: A burning arrow that tears through every enemy in a line for 130% weapon damage and sets them alight: they burn for 3 seconds.

volley.name: Frost Volley
volley.desc: Loose a flight of frost arrows into the sky: they rain on the cursor for over a second, hitting everything within 4 metres again and again and chilling them (40% slower); the ground stays frozen for a few seconds, slowing everything that stands in it or crosses it.

snare.name: Thunderstep
snare.desc: Backflip away from the pointer, driving a thunderstone into a gold storm sigil where you stood. A moment later it detonates: everything on it is stunned and hurt, and lightning leaps on into the 3 nearest others beyond it.

beast.name: Spirit Beast
beast.desc: Your Spirit Beast hunts at your side from the start (and you run 10% faster with it). Command it: on an enemy it pounces and fights it, on open ground it holds there, on yourself it comes back. Each command rouses you both: +40% damage for 12 seconds.

toxic.name: Pestilence Vial
toxic.desc: Pluck a vial of plague from your bandolier and lob it. A ring shows everyone where it will land. It bursts for a small hit and leaves a contaminated pool 2.6 metres wide for 3.5 seconds: anything standing in it is poisoned and keeps rotting for 2 seconds after it steps out. Pools of the same kind don't stack.

swarm.name: Swarmcraft
swarm.desc: Uncork your reliquary: a swarm of plague flies flies to the spot and hangs there for 6 seconds, biting whatever is inside and harrying it (attacks and casts 25% slower). Use it again to send the swarm somewhere else (twice). It never chases anyone, it's slower than a running man, and a dodge roll through it scatters it for a moment. The cooldown starts when it comes home.

bloom.name: Corpse Bloom
bloom.desc: Drive a seed into the ground. It grows for a second, then breathes for 6 seconds: every 2 seconds its ring of roots draws in and a spore pulse hits everything within 3.5 metres. Anyone who stood still while the ring drew in is snared by its roots for 0.6 seconds. In the Battlegrounds other players can break it with three blows.

fog.name: Fog of the Forgotten
fog.desc: Dash your censer at your feet and hop 4 metres back from the pointer. Pale fog 6 metres across hangs for 6 seconds: other players outside it can't see anyone inside, and inside it everyone within 3.5 metres is seen. You move 25% faster in it; monsters beyond 3.5 metres lose track of you in it; striking from it reveals you for a moment.

transfusion.name: Transfusion
transfusion.desc: Drive the needle of your apparatus into your arm: for 2 seconds you take 45% less damage and move at 70% speed, and slows, snares and Blight are washed out of you. What the tanks soak heals you afterwards (up to 15% of your life). Attacking ends it early.

experiment.name: The Last Experiment
experiment.desc: Slam down your vat (everyone sees an 8-metre warning ring) and crank it for 2.5 seconds. Then the glass bursts, the thing inside crawls out and the ring becomes a quarantine for 7 seconds: spores, Blight and a 20% slow inside, and the creature lumbers at the nearest foe, spewing. A stun, another skill or walking away from the vat bursts it early, only 5 metres wide. In the Battlegrounds other players can break the vat while you crank it (three blows: the experiment fails) and kill the creature (four).

covenant.name: Fel Covenant
covenant.desc: Seal a pact with what waits beyond: +40% damage for 12 seconds, and Drain Life forks to two more enemies and heals twice as much.

w_corruption.name: Corruption
w_corruption.desc: Curse a foe up to 15 m away: 240% spell damage over 10 seconds. Cheap; casting it again refreshes it.

w_malediction.name: Malediction
w_malediction.desc: A fel bolt for 90% spell damage, +50% for every one of your curses on the target (up to five: 315%). Standing in your plague pool counts as a curse.

w_unending.name: Unending Rot
w_unending.desc: A curse for 12 seconds (180% spell damage at the start) whose ticks grow 15% stronger for every second the foe has carried one of your curses without a break (up to four times as strong). A clean foe starts again.

w_festering.name: Festering Hex
w_festering.desc: A hex for 15 seconds: every 5 seconds it bursts for 120% spell damage and stuns the foe for half a second.

w_leeching.name: Leeching Curse
w_leeching.desc: A curse for 8 seconds: 160% spell damage over its life, and every tick heals you for half of what it dealt.

w_reckoning.name: Reckoning
w_reckoning.desc: The rare curse: for 6 seconds, each of its ticks deals as much as all your other curses on the foe tick for together.

w_terrify.name: Terrify
w_terrify.desc: Point at a foe within 8 m: it is frozen in terror for 1.5 seconds (a player flees for 1 second). Feared foes take 20% more from your spells.

w_effigy.name: Dread Totem
w_effigy.desc: Raise a vine-choked jungle idol up to 12 m away for 8 seconds. The first three foes to come within 4 m are frightened for 1 second as its void eyes flare and its wisps lash out.

w_darkwind.name: Void Wisp
w_darkwind.desc: Loose a wisp of void light at a foe: it bounces on to up to five enemies, 90% spell damage and a one-second slow each. Feared or bound foes take double.

w_crowstorm.name: Eclipse Bloom
w_crowstorm.desc: Gather the void, then blink up to 8 m: a storm of void petals and wisps whirls 5 m round you for 5 seconds, 80% spell damage every half second, and everything caught as you land is feared for 1 second.

w_leechbolt.name: Leech Bolt
w_leechbolt.desc: A quick shadow bolt: 140% spell damage, and 30% of it heals you.

w_harvest.name: Thornlash
w_harvest.desc: Lash a whip of black thorned vines round you (5 m): 180% spell damage, and each foe hit heals you 4% of your life (8% when it is the only one).

w_soulfeast.name: Soul Feast
w_soulfeast.desc: Channel for 3 seconds: beams to every foe within 7 m drain 80% spell damage a second from each. Healing past full life hardens into a shield, up to 30% of your life.

pie.name: Cream Pie
pie.desc: Lob a cream pie at the cursor (12 m): a splat for 120% weapon damage and the target is Pied: monsters blinded for 2 seconds, a player's screen creamed at the edges and their aim assist gone for 1.5 seconds. The same target can't be Pied again for 6 seconds.

peels.name: Banana Peels
peels.desc: Toss three banana peels in a fan ahead (they land 3 to 6 metres out and last 8 seconds; at most 6 down). Whoever steps on one slips: a player is knocked down for 0.7 seconds and slides on, a monster is stunned for 1 second. A dodge roll over a peel doesn't slip.

slide.name: Pratfall Slide
slide.desc: Belly-slide 7 metres the way you face, honking: foes in the way take 90% weapon damage and are shoved aside. You pop up with a ta-da.

doppel.name: Doppel-Doug
doppel.desc: Duck behind a puff of confetti: you turn invisible for 1.8 seconds while a balloon double of you runs off toward the cursor, waving. Struck, the double pops in a confetti burst that slows whoever is near for 1.5 seconds.

juggle.name: Pin Juggle
juggle.desc: Throw five flaming juggling pins in quick succession at the cursor; each bounces on to two more foes. 60% weapon damage as fire each.

bounce.name: Big Top Bounce
bounce.desc: Slam down a trampoline and bounce up to 10 metres to the cursor, landing in a belly-flop: 180% weapon damage in 3 metres and foes are launched for 0.8 seconds. A shadow and a whistle mark where you'll land.

car.name: Clown Car
car.desc: A tiny clown car screeches in and you drive it for 5 seconds: fast, unstoppable, ramming foes for 140% weapon damage and knocking them flying. Then it bursts in confetti and six mini clowns tumble out, sprint at the nearest foes and pie them.

earthshatter.name: Earthshatter
earthshatter.desc: A heavy two-handed slam: the wedge it will crack shows as you heave, then the ground splits ahead of you for 230% weapon damage plus a part that grows with your level, throwing foes back.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.desc: A ring of ice bursts out around you, 4 metres: cold damage, and everything it hits is chilled, slowed for 3 seconds.

arc.name: Arc
arc.desc: Lightning leaps from your hand into the nearest foe ahead and on to three more nearby, striking each.

frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
frost_breath.desc: The serpent lowers its head and breathes a freezing gale over everything in a cone 7 metres ahead for over a second: cold damage again and again, chilling (slowing) them; the ground frosts over and ice bursts up where it ends.

storm_arc.name: Storm Arc
storm_arc.desc: The wyvern rears up, the lightning in its wings flaring, and breathes a bolt into the nearest foe ahead that leaps on to four more nearby, striking each.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.desc: A roar that rallies your team: you and every ally within 8 metres deal +40% damage for 6 seconds, and the monsters near turn on you. In the Battlegrounds it is yours alone (no teams there yet).

a_multishot.name: Scatter Shot
a_multishot.desc: Loose five arrows in a fan: 55% weapon damage each. A foe close enough takes several.

a_glacial.name: Glacial Shard
a_glacial.desc: An arrow of ice that pierces every foe in a line for 110% weapon damage and chills them (40% slower) for 3 seconds.

a_explosive.name: Blast Arrow
a_explosive.desc: A fire arrow that bursts at the first foe it strikes or where its flight ends: 150% weapon damage to everything within 3.5 metres, setting them burning.

a_stormshot.name: Storm Shot
a_stormshot.desc: A charged arrow: 100% weapon damage to the first foe it strikes, then lightning leaps on to 4 more for 70%.

a_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
a_mark.desc: Mark the foe under the pointer for 8 seconds: it takes 35% more damage from everyone, and your wolf hunts it down.

a_barrage.name: Arrow Storm
a_barrage.desc: Loose a storm of arrows into the sky: for 1.5 seconds they rain on the cursor, striking everything within 4.5 metres six times for 32% weapon damage.

p_miasma.name: Miasma
p_miasma.desc: Smash a censer of plague at your feet: a cloud 4.5 metres wide hangs for 4 seconds, poisoning everything in it.

p_spread.name: Contagion
p_spread.desc: Curse the foe nearest the pointer with a creeping plague for 6 seconds: it is poisoned, and every second its poison leaps to all within 4 metres. If it dies cursed, the plague bursts to everyone within 5 metres.

k_whirl.name: Blade Storm
k_whirl.desc: Spin with the sword out: everything within 3.2 metres is struck twice for 70% weapon damage. Every blow of yours leaves a Holy Brand on its foe (up to 5).

k_aegis.name: Aegis
k_aegis.desc: Raise a holy ward worth 35% of your life for 5 seconds and call everything within 5 metres onto you. When it breaks or ends, it bursts: everything within 5 metres takes all the damage it soaked.

k_judgment.name: Judgment
k_judgment.desc: Call a pillar of holy light down on the pointer: 120% weapon damage within 3 metres, +45% for every Holy Brand on each foe (the brands are spent), and holy fire burns them.

k_rites.name: Last Rites
k_rites.desc: Leap at the foe nearest the pointer and bring the sword down: 150% weapon damage, +2% for every 1% of life it is missing. A kill makes Last Rites ready again.

r_deathmark.name: Death Mark
r_deathmark.desc: Mark the foe nearest the pointer. When the mark ends 3 seconds later it tears out half of everything you dealt it meanwhile (at least 150% weapon damage) as a soul you drink back.

r_wail.name: Banshee Wail
r_wail.desc: Scream: everything within 6 metres takes 60% weapon damage, is frozen in terror for 1.2 seconds and slowed by half for 2 more.

r_reap.name: Reaping Crescent
r_reap.desc: A great crescent of soul-fire sweeps out 5 metres in front of you: 170% weapon damage, and each foe it reaps heals you 2% of your life.

d_volcano.name: Volcano
d_volcano.desc: Tear open a volcano at the pointer: it hurls five meteors onto the foes around it over two seconds, each 85% weapon damage and setting them alight.

d_detonate.name: Hellbrand Detonation
d_detonate.desc: Every Branded foe within 10 metres erupts: 160% weapon damage, thrown up for 0.8 seconds, and the fire bursts onto those beside it. The Brands are spent.

d_pact.name: Blood Pact
d_pact.desc: Pay 15% of your life to the pit: for 8 seconds +35% damage and 6% of the damage you deal heals you.

u_barrage.name: Pie Barrage
u_barrage.desc: Fling six cream pies at once onto the foes around the pointer: each 80% weapon damage, and the first time a foe is Pied it is stunned and slowed.

u_bonanza.name: Banana Bonanza
u_bonanza.desc: Scatter eight banana peels in a ring round you: whatever steps on one goes down. Your next blow on a slipped foe within 4 seconds hits twice as hard.

u_cannon.name: Human Cannonball
u_cannon.desc: Fire yourself out of a cannon onto the pointer (14 metres): you land in a belly-flop that deals 260% weapon damage within 4.5 metres and knocks them down.

p_leech.name: Leech Jar
p_leech.desc: Lob a jar of blood leeches: for 5 seconds everything within 3 metres is poisoned, and every foe in it heals you 1.5% of your life a second.

k_steel.name: Sanctified Steel
k_steel.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

k_purify.name: Purifying Fire
k_purify.text: Holy Nova costs {cost:nova}% less mana and recharges {cd:nova}% faster.

k_consecrate.name: Consecration
k_consecrate.text: Holy Nova heals you {nova_heal}% of your life for every enemy it burns (up to 5).

k_wall.name: Shield Wall
k_wall.text: +{block}% chance to block with a shield.

k_guard.name: Iron Guard
k_guard.text: Block stops {block_dr}% more damage from the front.

k_unbroken.name: Unbreakable
k_unbroken.text: Battle Cry heals {cry_heal}% of your life and lasts {buff_dur} seconds longer.

k_ram.name: Battering Ram
k_ram.text: Charge hits {dmg:charge}% harder and recharges {cd:charge}% faster.

k_sword.name: Swordplay
k_sword.text: Your weapon attack deals {dmg:attack}% more damage.

k_command.name: Commander
k_command.text: Battle Cry's damage bonus is {buff_pow}% higher.

k_relentless.name: Relentless
k_relentless.text: Every enemy Charge smashes through takes {charge_cdr} second off your other cooldowns.

w_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
w_harvest.text: Each soul Spectral Rend tears out heals {rend_heal}% more of your life.

w_cruel.name: Cruelty
w_cruel.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

w_moon.name: Harvest Moon
w_moon.text: Spectral Rend's claws tear all the way round you.

w_slip.name: Slipstream
w_slip.text: Shadowstep recharges {cd:step}% faster and strikes {dmg:step}% harder.

w_hollow.name: Hollow Hunger
w_hollow.text: Soul Siphon costs {cost:siphon}% less mana and recharges {cd:siphon}% faster.

w_echo.name: Lingering Mist
w_echo.text: After Shadowstep you stay mist {veil} seconds longer, and its strike stuns {step_stun} seconds longer.

w_legion.name: Legion
w_legion.text: Phantom Assault and Haunting Grasp strike {dmg:phantom}% harder.

w_eternal.name: Eternal
w_eternal.text: Eternal Night's power lasts {buff_dur} seconds longer and Haunting Grasp holds {grasp_hold} seconds longer.

w_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
w_siphon.text: +{ls}% of the damage you deal comes back as life.

w_rider.name: Fourth Rider
w_rider.text: Phantom Assault sends a fourth phantom, and Eternal Night deals {dmg:night}% more damage.

d_edge.name: Infernal Edge
d_edge.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

d_inferno.name: Inferno
d_inferno.text: Molten Fists crack the ground a metre further and wider, and what they light burns twice as long.

d_bargain.name: Cheap Fury
d_bargain.text: Infernal Charge costs {cost:icharge}% and Brimstone Hurl {cost:hurl}% less mana.

d_ferocity.name: Ferocity
d_ferocity.text: Fault of the Pit and Brimstone Hurl deal {dmg:cslam}% more damage.

d_pack.name: Slow Cooling
d_pack.text: Fault of the Pit stays molten {trail_dur} seconds longer.

d_tithe.name: Stampede
d_tithe.text: Infernal Charge recharges {cd:icharge}% faster and hits {dmg:icharge}% harder.

d_oath.name: Pit Lord
d_oath.text: Pit-born's damage bonus (after Wrath of the Pit) is {buff_pow}% higher.

d_legion.name: Twin Boulders
d_legion.text: Brimstone Hurl throws a second boulder beside the first.

d_erupt.name: Long Wrath
d_erupt.text: Wrath of the Pit's meteors rain {wrath_dur} seconds longer and it recharges {cd:wrath}% faster.

d_hunger.name: Hungering Fire
d_hunger.text: +{ls}% of the damage you deal comes back as life.

d_furnace.name: Meteor Storm
d_furnace.text: Wrath of the Pit calls two meteors at a time.

l_fork.name: Forking Beam
l_fork.text: Drain Life forks to {drain_fork} more enemy.

l_glut.name: Soul Glut
l_glut.text: Life Drain Life pulls in past your full life fills {drain_glut}% as much mana.

l_virulence.name: Virulence
l_virulence.text: Blight Bolt and its pools deal {dmg:blight}% more damage.

l_spread.name: Spreading Rot
l_spread.text: Blight bursts and pools are {blight_size}% wider.

l_malice.name: Malice
l_malice.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit with your weapon and Soul Shackles.

l_chains.name: Iron Chains
l_chains.text: Soul Shackles deal {dmg:shackles}% more damage and bind {shackle_dur} seconds longer.

l_dark.name: Dark Pact
l_dark.text: Fel Covenant recharges {cd:covenant}% faster and its damage bonus is {buff_pow}% higher.

d_flop.name: Belly Flop
d_flop.text: Big Top Bounce deals {dmg:bounce}% more damage.

d_finale.name: Grand Finale
d_finale.text: All your damage +{dmg}% and Clown Car recharges {cd:car}% faster.

p_linger.name: Lingering Rot
p_linger.text: Poison keeps working {poison_dur} seconds longer after a foe leaves a pool.

p_ignite.name: Rank Growth
p_ignite.text: Corpse Bloom reaches {bloom_size}% further and its pulses hit {dmg:bloom}% harder.

p_inferno.name: The Hive Obeys
p_inferno.text: The swarm can be turned {swarm_redirect} more time and stays {swarm_dur} second longer.

p_spring.name: Dense Fog
p_spring.text: Fog of the Forgotten hangs {fog_dur} seconds longer.

p_snare.name: Strangling Roots
p_snare.text: Corpse Bloom's roots hold {bloom_snare} seconds longer.

p_spread.name: Larger Tanks
p_spread.text: Transfusion heals up to {trans_cap}% more of your life.

p_last.name: Magnum Opus
p_last.text: The Last Experiment's quarantine is {exp_size}% wider and it recharges {cd:experiment}% faster.

a_draw.name: Heavy Draw
a_draw.text: Your bow shots deal {dmg:attack}% more damage.

a_pyre.name: Pyre
a_pyre.text: Burning from Fire Arrow lasts and hurts {burn_dmg}% more.

a_embers.name: Ember Fangs
a_embers.text: Your wolf's bites set foes alight: {wolf_burn}% of each bite burns them every second for 3 seconds.

a_dead.name: Deadeye
a_dead.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

a_split.name: Split Arrow
a_split.text: Every bow shot flies as three arrows (the outer two at half damage).

a_howl.name: Winter Howl
a_howl.text: Your wolf's pounce chills everything within 3.5 metres of where it lands.

a_rain.name: Endless Rain
a_rain.text: Frost Volley recharges {cd:volley}% faster and costs {cost:volley}% less mana.

a_shatter.name: Shatter
a_shatter.text: Chilled enemies take 20% more damage from your arrows.

a_jaws.name: Thunder Jaws
a_jaws.text: Thunderstep's sigil deals {dmg:snare}% more damage and stuns {snare_dur} seconds longer.

a_arc.name: Forked Lightning
a_arc.text: Thunderstep's lightning leaps to {arc_count} more enemies.

a_trapper.name: Aftershock
a_trapper.text: Thunderstep's sigil strikes {snare_max} more time(s), a little weaker each time.

a_pack.name: Pack Hunter
a_pack.text: The hunt your commands rouse is {buff_pow}% stronger.

a_alpha.name: Alpha
a_alpha.text: A second wolf runs with you.

g_instinct.name: Killer Instinct
g_instinct.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

g_thirst.name: Bloodthirst
g_thirst.text: {ls}% of the damage you deal heals you.

x_execute.name: Executioner
x_execute.text: Your hits on foes under {below}% life deal +{more}% damage.

x_momentum.name: Momentum
x_momentum.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.

x_vampire.name: Vampiric
x_vampire.text: Each kill heals you for {pct}% of your life.

x_chain.name: Chain Reaction
x_chain.text: Monsters you kill explode: {pct}% of their life to everything within {r} m. Kills it causes explode too.

x_undying.name: Undying
x_undying.text: A blow that would kill you leaves you at {life}% life instead (once every {secs} seconds).

x_thorns.name: Retribution
x_thorns.text: Monsters that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back.

x_berserk.name: Berserker
x_berserk.text: Up to +{most}% damage as your life runs low.

x_echo.name: Echo
x_echo.text: A skill with a cooldown has a {chance}% chance to be ready again at once.

x_frenzy.name: Frenzy
x_frenzy.text: Critical hits give +{ias}% attack speed for {secs} seconds.

x_lucky.name: Lucky Charm
x_lucky.text: Camp chests offer one more choice.

x_treasure.name: Treasure Hunter
x_treasure.text: Camp chests hold {loot_plus} more consumable for you.

x_gemcutter.name: Gemcutter
x_gemcutter.text: Camp chests hold a gem twice as often, and rare gems more often.

x_ward.name: Second Skin
x_ward.text: A ward soaks blows worth {ward_bonus}% of your life; it refills out of combat.

x_conduit.name: Elemental Conduit
x_conduit.text: Your burns last {burn_dur}% longer and hurt {burn_pct}% more; your chills last {chill_pct}% longer.

x_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
x_bloodlust.text: Under {below}% life, {pct}% of the damage your hits deal heals you.

x_adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
x_adrenaline.text: Each kill: +{frw}% run speed for {secs} seconds.

a_kindling.name: Kindling
a_kindling.text: Your burns deal +{burn_pct}% damage and last {burn_dur}% longer.

a_firetip.name: Fire-Tipped
a_firetip.text: Plain shots set what they strike burning ({pct}% of the hit a second).

a_wildfire.name: Wildfire
a_wildfire.text: A burning foe that dies sets everything within {r} m alight.

a_conflag.name: Conflagration
a_conflag.text: Burning foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

a_phoenix.name: Phoenix Quiver
a_phoenix.text: Every {n}th plain shot looses a free Fire Arrow.

a_biting.name: Biting Cold
a_biting.text: Your chills last {chill_pct}% longer and slow more.

a_frostbite.name: Frostbite
a_frostbite.text: Chilled foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

a_glacial.name: Rimed Arrows
a_glacial.text: Plain shots chill what they strike.

a_shards.name: Ice Shards
a_shards.text: A chilled foe that dies shatters: {pct}% weapon damage to everything within {r} m, chilling them.

a_zero.name: Absolute Zero
a_zero.text: Every {n}th hit on a chilled foe freezes it solid for {secs} seconds.

a_static.name: Static Charge
a_static.text: Thunderstep, Arc and Storm Shot deal +{dmg:snare}% damage.

a_forked.name: Forked Shots
a_forked.text: Plain shots leap on as lightning to {jumps} more foes ({pct}% damage).

a_overcharge.name: Overcharge
a_overcharge.text: Critical hits call lightning down on the target: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m.

a_quarry.name: Quarry
a_quarry.text: The foe you shot last takes +{more}% damage from you and your wolf.

a_packleader.name: Pack Leader
a_packleader.text: Your wolf deals {wolf_dmg}% more damage and each bite heals you {wolf_heal}% of your life.

a_ricochet.name: Ricochet
a_ricochet.text: Plain shots that strike a foe glance on to {bounces} more ({pct}% damage).

a_up_fan.name: Wide Fan
a_up_fan.text: Scatter Shot looses {multishot_more} more arrows and hits {dmg:a_multishot}% harder.

a_up_cluster.name: Cluster Charge
a_up_cluster.text: Blast Arrow's burst is {blast_r}% wider and {dmg:a_explosive}% stronger.

a_up_shatter.name: Shatterpoint
a_up_shatter.text: Glacial Shard freezes foes already chilled for a moment, and hits {dmg:a_glacial}% harder.

a_up_overload.name: Overload
a_up_overload.text: Storm Shot's lightning leaps to {storm_jumps} more foes and hits {dmg:a_stormshot}% harder.

a_up_death.name: Marked for Death
a_up_death.text: A marked foe that dies makes Hunter's Mark ready again and gives you +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds.

p_septic.name: Septic Wounds
p_septic.text: Poisoned foes take +{more}% damage from your blows.

p_toxblood.name: Toxic Blood
p_toxblood.text: {pct}% of the poison damage you deal heals you.

p_necrosis.name: Necrosis
p_necrosis.text: Poison grows {grow}% crueller every second a foe stays poisoned (up to +{most}%).

p_carrier.name: Plague Carrier
p_carrier.text: Your cane's blows pass a poisoned foe's poison to another within {r} m.

p_contagion.name: Contagion
p_contagion.text: A poisoned foe that dies passes its poison to the {n} nearest within {r} m.

p_pandemic.name: Pandemic
p_pandemic.text: A poisoned foe that dies bursts in a plague cloud: {pct}% weapon damage and poison to all within {r} m. Its dead burst too.

p_hunger.name: Ravenous Swarm
p_hunger.text: The swarm bites for +{dmg:swarm}% and each bite heals you {swarm_heal}% of your life.

p_overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
p_overgrowth.text: Corpse Bloom pulses {bloom_rate}% more often and reaches {bloom_size}% further.

p_rotfeast.name: Feast of Rot
p_rotfeast.text: Each poisoned foe that dies heals you {pct}% of your life and makes you +15% faster for 3 s.

p_volatile.name: Volatile Reagents
p_volatile.text: Pestilence Vial bursts on impact for {vial_burst}% weapon damage.

p_double.name: Double Dose
p_double.text: Pestilence Vial throws a second vial beside the first.

p_up_miasma.name: Choking Miasma
p_up_miasma.text: Miasma spreads {miasma_r}% wider and slows everything in it.

p_up_epidemic.name: Epidemic
p_up_epidemic.text: When a cursed foe dies, Contagion's curse leaps to the nearest foe with its time renewed.

p_up_leech.name: Bloated Leeches
p_up_leech.text: Leech Jar heals {leech_heal}% more and lasts {leech_t} seconds longer.

p_tinctures.name: Strong Tinctures
p_tinctures.text: Potions restore {pot}% more; skills recharge {cdr}% faster.

k_up_judgment.name: Wrath of Heaven
k_up_judgment.text: Judgment calls {judgment_more} more pillars round the first, each {dmg:k_judgment}% stronger.

k_up_aegis.name: Bastion
k_up_aegis.text: Aegis's ward is {aegis_pct}% of your life stronger and comes back {cd:k_aegis}% sooner; its burst is twice as hard.

k_up_whirl.name: Unending Spin
k_up_whirl.text: Blade Storm spins {whirl_more} more time and hits {dmg:k_whirl}% harder.

k_up_rites.name: No Quarter
k_up_rites.text: A Last Rites kill also gives you +30% damage and +20% run speed for 4 seconds.

k_brands.name: Searing Brands
k_brands.text: Holy Brands stack {brand_max} higher and each one burns its foe a little.

k_zealot.name: Zealot
k_zealot.text: Your sword sets foes alight with holy fire ({pct}% of the blow a second).

k_iron.name: Iron Hide
k_iron.text: +{armor_pct}% defense and a ward of {ward_bonus}% of your life that refills out of combat.

k_cleave.name: Cleaving Blows
k_cleave.text: Your sword's blows cleave into {bounces} more foes beside the one struck ({pct}%).

k_sacred.name: Sacred Flame
k_sacred.text: Critical hits set foes alight with holy fire ({pct}% of the hit a second).

k_martyr.name: Martyr's Resolve
k_martyr.text: Monsters that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back in holy fire.

k_onslaught.name: Onslaught
k_onslaught.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.

r_up_mark.name: Marked Soul
r_up_mark.text: Death Mark tears out {mark_pct}% more and comes back {cd:r_deathmark}% sooner.

r_up_wail.name: Keening
r_up_wail.text: Banshee Wail reaches {wail_r}% further and terrifies {wail_t} seconds longer.

r_up_reap.name: Harvest of Souls
r_up_reap.text: Reaping Crescent hits {dmg:r_reap}% harder and heals {reap_heal}% more for each it reaps.

r_reaper.name: Reaper
r_reaper.text: Your hits on foes under {below}% life deal +{more}% damage.

r_soulfeast.name: Soul Feast
r_soulfeast.text: Each kill heals you {pct}% of your life.

r_dread.name: Dread
r_dread.text: Every hit chills its foe with dread.

d_up_volcano.name: Ring of Fire
d_up_volcano.text: Volcano hurls {volcano_more} more meteors, each {dmg:d_volcano}% harder.

d_up_detonate.name: Chain Brand
d_up_detonate.text: Hellbrand Detonation Brands everything its eruptions strike.

d_hellfire.name: Hellfire
d_hellfire.text: Every blow sets its foe alight ({pct}% of the hit a second).

d_eruption.name: Eruption
d_eruption.text: Foes you kill erupt: {pct}% of their life to all within {r} m.

d_pitborn.name: Pitborn Hide
d_pitborn.text: Monsters that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back.

u_up_cannon.name: Extra Gunpowder
u_up_cannon.text: Human Cannonball lands {cannon_r}% wider and {dmg:u_cannon}% harder.

u_encore.name: Standing Ovation
u_encore.text: A skill with a cooldown has a {chance}% chance to be ready again at once.

u_slapstick.name: Comic Timing
u_slapstick.text: Critical hits give +{ias}% attack speed for {secs} seconds.

s_permafrost.name: Permafrost
s_permafrost.text: Every {n}th hit on a chilled foe freezes it solid for {secs} seconds.

s_shatter.name: Brittle
s_shatter.text: Chilled foes take +{more}% damage from your hits.

v_tempest.name: Tempest
v_tempest.text: Critical hits call lightning down: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m.

y_claws.name: Rending Claws
y_claws.text: Claws and bites deal +{dmg:attack}%; +{crit}% critical chance.

y_fury.name: Primal Fury
y_fury.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.

v_static.name: Static Claws
v_static.text: Claws leap on as lightning to {jumps} more foes ({pct}%).

phoenix.name: Phoenix Ember
phoenix.text: Once this run, a killing blow is refused: you rise at {life}% life in a burst of fire.

tempest.name: Eye of the Tempest
tempest.text: Every {n}th hit calls lightning down on its foe ({pct}% weapon damage).

hunger.name: Hunger Stone
hunger.text: Every kill adds +{per}% damage for the rest of the run (up to {most}%).

seer.name: Seer's Eye
seer.text: Camp chests offer one more choice.

crownshard.name: Shard of the Crown
crownshard.text: Camp chests' offers are one step rarer.
